Free online converters

21 converters that run entirely in your browser — free, no signup, no tracking. Part of the Unit & Data group.

  • Unit ConverterThis Unit Converter tool converts values across various units. Select your category, input a value, and choose your from and to units.
  • Epoch ConverterEpoch Converter — free online tool. Unix time is timezone-free: the same number is the same instant everywhere on Earth. Works on mobile and offline.
  • Base64 EncoderBase64 Encoder — free online tool. Base64 makes data safe for text-only channels like email headers and JSON; it is encoding, not encryption, and anyone can reverse it. Works on mobile and offline.
